opennyai_summary.decision:
In view of the aforesaid fact and circumstances this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to:
Admit the writ petition (1) direct the Opp.parties to extend benefit under the Right to Fair compensation and Transparency in land acquisition Rehabilitations and resettlement Act, 2013.
(2) And further be pleased to direct the Opp.party no.2 to make a inquiry and release the petitioners share for the purpose of compensation.
As agreed by learned counsel for the parties and after going through the records, this Court,
without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, disposes of the Writ Petition directing Opposite Party No.2 to consider the representation filed by the petitioner vide Annexure-3Series,
and pass appropriate order in accordance with law within a period of three months from the date of production of certified copy of this order.
